title: Calorie crop bed planning sheet
summary: Separates morale vegetables from crops that provide meaningful calories over time.
content: Calorie crop bed planning sheet is a practical offline routine for calorie planning. Mark each crop as quick vitamins, calories, protein support, seasoning, seed source, or trade item. Do not fill all beds with low-calorie salad if long-term food security is the goal. Estimate space, water, time to harvest, storage method, and cooking fuel need. Weigh harvests from test beds so future plans use real local output. Replace crops that consume too much water for too little food.
steps: Replace crops that consume too much water for too little food.
